content: HTCA-Project repo had a 21-day quiet streak through 2026-04-25. One indexing event on 04/05 (Grok found templetwo/HTCA-Project), then zero external mentions or citations for the remainder of the month despite continuing daily scans. The Christmas 2025 release produced exactly one indexing event in April. Visibility ≠ traction. The quiet-streak is a usable instrument: each future publishing event can be measured against whether it breaks the streak. If a release doesn't break the streak, output didn't propagate — tight feedback loop.
